      "answer": "Yes"

      "question": "Does the paper report in vitro drug susceptibility data?",

      "evidence_location": "main_text",
      "rationale": "Only genotypic resistance analysis (in silico interpretation of SDRM) was performed; no phenotypic susceptibility assay, IC50/EC50, or fold-change data are reported anywhere in the paper.",
      "answer": "No"
    },
    {
      "qid": 3,
      "question": "Were sequences from the paper made publicly available?",
      "evidence": "The RT-generated sequences were deposited in the National Institutes of Health GenBank database under accession numbers PP280627 to PP280757.",

      "evidence_location": "main_text",
      "rationale": "Only the partial reverse transcriptase gene was sequenced; protease and integrase were explicitly not sequenced.",
      "answer": "RT"

      "qid": 10,
      "question": "What method was used for sequencing?",
      "evidence": "Purified and quantified polymerase chain reaction products were sequenced by using Big Dye Terminator v3.1 (Life Technologies, Courtaboeuf, France), and electrophoresis was performed on the ABI 3100 Avant sequencer (Applied Biosystems, France).",
      "evidence_location": "main_text",
      "rationale": "Big Dye Terminator chemistry with capillary electrophoresis on an ABI 3100 instrument is classic Sanger (dideoxyterminator) sequencing.",
      "answer": "Sanger sequencing"

      "qid": 11,
      "question": "What type of samples were sequenced?",

      "rationale": "Viral RNA was extracted from dried blood spots and from plasma (recovered from venous whole blood); both specimen types were sequenced.",
      "answer": "DBS, Plasma"

    {
      "qid": 12,
      "question": "Were any sequences obtained from individuals with virological failure on a treatment regimen?",
      "evidence": "The inclusion criteria for patients in the sites were to be HIV-1-positive men or women, aged at least 18, ART-naive (defined as never having received any antiretroviral therapy, including prevention of mother-to-child transmission [PMTCT] regimens), and newly diagnosed.",

      "rationale": "This is an observational cross-sectional WHO HIV drug resistance surveillance survey; there is no randomization to treatment, blinding, placebo control, or trial phase described (only sites, not patients, were randomly selected).",
      "answer": "No"
    },

      "qid": 14,
      "question": "Does the paper report HIV sequences from individuals who had previously received ARV drugs?",
      "evidence": "ART-naive (defined as never having received any antiretroviral therapy, including prevention of mother-to-child transmission [PMTCT] regimens), and newly diagnosed based on the patient and the healthcare provider declarations.",
      "evidence_location": "main_text",
      "rationale": "All sequenced individuals were explicitly ART-naive with no history of any antiretroviral drug exposure, so no sequences came from ARV-experienced persons.",
      "answer": "No"
    },
